body [alice 2026-08-14 09:00]
  The renderer drops everything after the first page of a paginated issue timeline, and the counts header still reports the full total, so the output reads as complete when it is not. Reproduced on three repos of different sizes; the cutoff is always exactly one hundred timeline items, which is the page size.
